messages: It seems #p228# in #m010001050# can make another type of Omok Set.

#b#p228##k in #m010001050# said he could make a new type of Omok Set if I brought him a few items. He said I can easily get them by defeating #o6#, #o7#, and #o8#, found around #m10001000#. I should try to gather them when I have the time.

I brought the requested items to #p228# in #m010001050# and received a #b#t4080001##k! With this, I can play the Omok Mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask #p228# if I want to know more about the mini-game.
name: Make a Slime & Pig Omok Set
